Balance Sheet Group — Edit

The Balance Sheet Group form is used to create and edit balance sheet account groups.

Groups organize related accounts on the balance sheet for better financial reporting.

This form contains the following fields:

Name

Enter the name of this balance sheet group. This will appear as a heading on the balance sheet.

Group

Select a parent group if you want to nest this group under another group on the balance sheet.

Position

Set the display order for this group. Lower numbers appear first on the balance sheet.
